description_en: Modifies a defense rule against brute-force attacks
name: ModifyAntiBruteForceRule

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the access source
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en: The ID of the defense rule against brute-force attacks
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The name of the defense rule against brute-force attacks
parameters.help_zh: 暴力破解防御规则的名称
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The threshold for the period of time during which logon failures are counted, in minutes. Valid values:

1: 1 minute
2: 2 minutes
5: 5 minutes
10: 10 minutes
15: 15 minutes
parameters.help_zh:
账号登录失败的时间的阈值，单位为分钟。取值：

1:1分钟
2：2分钟
5：5分钟
10：10分钟
15：15分钟
parameters.name: span

parameters.help_en:
The threshold for the number of logon failures. Valid values:

2: 2 times
3: 3 times
4: 4 times
5: 5 times
10: 10 times
50: 50 times
80: 80 times
100: 100 times
parameters.name: fail_count

parameters.help_en:
The duration for which logon is prohibited, in minutes. Valid values:

5: 5 minutes
15: 15 minutes
30: 30 minutes
60: 1 hour
120: 2 hours
360: 6 hours
720: 12 hours
1440: 24 hours
10080: 7 days
52560000: permanent (100 years)
parameters.name: forbidden_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the defense rule against brute-force attacks is set as the default policy in Settings. Valid values:

true: The rule is set as the default policy.

false: The rule is not set as the default policy
parameters.help_zh:
添加的暴力破解防御规则是否设置为默认策略。取值：

true：设置为默认策略

false：不设置为默认策略
parameters.name: default_rule

parameters.help_en: The list of servers to which the defense rule against brute-force attacks applies
parameters.help_zh: 暴力破解防御规则生效的服务器列表
parameters.name: uuid_list

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable RDP interception. This is enabled by default. Valid values:
on: enabled
off: disabled
fields.help_zh:
是否修改RDP拦截方式，默认开启，取值：
on：开启
off：关闭
fields.name: rdp

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable SqlServer interception. This is disabled by default. Valid values:
on: enabled
off: disabled
fields.help_zh:
是否修改SqlServer拦截方式，默认关闭，取值：
on：开启
off：关闭
fields.name: sql_server

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable SSH interception. This is enabled by default. Valid values:
on: enabled
off: disabled
fields.help_zh:
是否修改SSH拦截方式，默认开启，取值：
on：开启
off：关闭
fields.name: ssh

parameters.help_en: The protocol types that the defense rule against brute-force attacks supports for interception
parameters.help_zh: 暴力破解规则支持拦截的协议类型
parameters.name: protocol_type

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The China Chinese Cloud generates a unique ID for each request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
